page_title: WOL 1-2 WHU | Wolves v West Ham 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+14' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) gets a yellow card.
90+12' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+11' The goal by Wolves is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
90+10' The Wolves players halt their celebrations as referee Tony Harrington makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+9' Max Kilman (Wolves) rises high to head the corner in the net and beyond the goalkeeper.
90+9' Corner kick. Joao Gomes (Wolves) is ready to send the ball into the box.
90+8' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
90+6' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
90+1' It's like he was asking for a caution. Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) receives a yellow card.
90' 10 additional min. will be played.
90' Gary O'Neil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Bueno (Wolves) replacing Matt Doherty.
90' Here comes a substitution. Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Thomas Doyle.
88' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) is the one who receives a yellow card.
84' 1 - 2 Unbelievable! James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) scores direct from the corner. He curls the ball and it goes straight into the back of the net. 1:2.
84' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
78' Toti (Wolves) sees a yellow card from Tony Harrington after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
75' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Pablo Sarabia will be replaced by Leon Chiwome (Wolves).
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Boubacar Traore (Wolves) coming on for Mario Lemina.
73' 1 - 1 Goal! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Jose Sa.
72' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
72' Max Kilman (Wolves) handles the ball inside the penalty area. West Ham are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
65' The goal by West Ham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
64' The West Ham players halt their celebrations as referee Tony Harrington makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
63' It's in the back of the net! Emerson (West Ham) finds a way to slip the ball past the goalkeeper!
60' West Ham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

60' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) as his effort only hit the wall. The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' Tony Harrington blows his whistle. Matheus Cunha (Wolves) commits a foul after dangerous play. West Ham win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
57' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
57' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will take a corner kick.
55' Rayan Ait-Nouri doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Matheus Cunha (Wolves) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
54' Problems for David Moyes as Jarrod Bowen is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) replaces him.
51' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
50' Looks like Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
48' Michail Antonio (West Ham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Jose Sa makes a save.
46' Here is a change. Tomas Soucek is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Michail Antonio (West Ham).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Vladimir Coufal comes off for Benjamin Johnson (West Ham).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tony Harrington ignores the protests.
42' Joao Gomes (Wolves) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Lukasz Fabianski is equal to it and makes an easy save.
38' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' A pass into the penalty area from Joao Gomes (Wolves) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
36' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Now West Ham have a corner.
33' 1 - 0 Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) gave the goalkeeper no chance from the penalty. Lukasz Fabianski failed to reach the ball, which bounced off the post into the bottom right corner.
32' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is going to take the penalty!
31' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Emerson (West Ham). Tony Harrington saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Wolves are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
30' The foul by Emerson (West Ham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tony Harrington.
29' What an opportunity! Matt Doherty (Wolves) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!
26' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the right post.
24' Half-chance! Joao Gomes (Wolves) plays a pass into the box, but Lukasz Fabianski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.
23' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
21' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Lukasz Fabianski is alert and denies him.
18' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
14' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
12' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
11' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
9' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Tony Harrington blows for a foul after Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
6' Neat passing move from Wolves in order to create new attacking opportunities.
3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Wolves will kick-off.
Tony Harrington will referee today's match.
